# Settling INV-UNPAID with the CAD split of a USD-quoted entry.
#
# The invoice is CAD and the split holds 100.00 CAD, so the settlement is what
# the split already says and the link needs no rate. What the entry is quoted
# in — USD, the currency the cash arrived in — says nothing about that.
#
# It says something on the way back out, which is the point: a CAD `--to`
# matches the split's own commodity *and* "kept in CAD where the entry is
# quoted elsewhere", and the first is the one that applies.
#
# What this fixture produces: the split on `Assets:Accounts Receivable` at
# −100.00 CAD, valued −75.00 USD, in the invoice's lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_unlinking_a_linked_transaction.py.
invoice "INV-UNPAID"
	customer_id: "C-UNAPPLY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Posted, never paid"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-UNPAID"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-18
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		txn_guid: "11223344556677889900112233445566"
		txn_split_guid: "33445566778899001122334455661122"
